title: Readiness Estimator: Olivine Spreading Programs
definition: Estimates Olivine Spreading Programs readiness from component maturity.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mine supply monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or beach trials maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Olivine Spreading Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Olivine Spreading Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Olivine Spreading Programs — programs spreading olivine for weathering.

Phase 1 — Prove (mine supply): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (beach trials): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (farmland use): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and coasts-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
